meta.title: RUDBECKIA HIRTA
meta.note: world units normalised to unit radius, Y up

parts.label: PEDUNCLE
parts.note: axis, 12 mm · base to apex, slow twist
parts.desc: the peduncle, the green stalk and stem supporting the flower head

parts.label: TRICHOMES
parts.note: eglandular hairs · root first, up the axis
parts.desc: the trichomes, stiff rough hairs covering the stem

parts.label: INVOLUCRE
parts.note: phyllary ring, 2 series · one turn, clockwise
parts.desc: the involucre, a ring of green leafy bracts enclosing the base of the flower head

parts.label: DISC FLORETS
parts.desc: the disc florets, small tubular fertile flowers packed at the centre of the head, bearing pollen and seed

parts.label: POLLEN
parts.desc: grains of pollen carried on the disc florets

parts.label: RAY FLORETS
parts.note: ligulate, sterile · ligule by ligule, base to tip
parts.desc: the ray florets, the long flat yellow petals radiating around the outside of the flower head
